key.name: dark-full-screen
key.description: If true the bar transparency will be reverted to original state when a window is touching the bar, false and the bar remains transparent at all time

key.name: auto-foreground-color
key.description: Sample the wallpaper behind the top bar and use dark text on bright wallpapers, light text on dark wallpapers.

key.name: foreground-luminance-threshold
key.description: Use dark text when the sampled background luminance is higher than this value.

key.name: sample-count
key.description: Number of points sampled from the background behind the top bar.

key.name: disable-text-shadow
key.description: If true, text shadows will be disabled in the top bar. If false (default), text will have shadows to improve readability on transparent backgrounds.

key.name: debug-logging
key.description: Write the background sampling results (luminance, sample count, duration) to the system log.
